sql.if: and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.status='0' where ur.user_id=#{currentUserId} and ( #{permissions} is null or #{permissions} = '' or exists ( select 1 from sys_role_menu rm inner join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id where rm.role_id = r.role_id and m.status = '0' and m.perms is not null and m.perms != '' and find_in_set(m.perms, #{permissions}) > 0 ) ) and ( r.data_scope='1' or (r.data_scope='2' and c.dept_id in (select dept_id from sys_role_dept where role_id=r.role_id)) or (r.data_scope='3' and c.dept_id=#{currentDeptId}) or (r.data_scope='4' and c.dept_id in (select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id=#{currentDeptId} or find_in_set(#{currentDeptId}, sd.ancestors))) or (r.data_scope='5' and (c.owner_id=#{currentUserId} or c.main_lawyer_id=#{currentUserId} or find_in_set(#{currentUserId}, ifnull(c.assistant_lawyer_ids,'')))) ) )

mapper.sql: select c.*, u.nick_name ownerName, d.dept_name deptName from biz_case c left join sys_user u on u.user_id=c.owner_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=c.dept_id
mapper.select: select * from biz_case where contract_id=#{contractId} and del_flag='0' limit 1
mapper.update: update biz_case set main_lawyer_id=#{mainLawyerId}, main_lawyer_name=#{mainLawyerName}, assistant_lawyer_ids=#{assistantLawyerIds}, assistant_lawyer_names=#{assistantLawyerNames}, priority=#{priority}, estimated_cycle=#{estimatedCycle}, plan_start_date=#{planStartDate}, estimated_workload=#{estimatedWorkload}, case_status=#{caseStatus}, current_node=#{currentNode}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate() where case_id=#{caseId} and del_flag='0' and case_status='pending'

update biz_case
case_status=#{caseStatus}, current_node=#{currentNode},
main_lawyer_id=null, main_lawyer_name=null, assistant_lawyer_ids=null, assistant_lawyer_names=null,
update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate()
where case_id=#{caseId} and del_flag='0' and case_status in ('confirming','processing')
mapper.select: select count(1) from biz_case c where c.case_id=#{caseId} and c.del_flag='0' and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.status='0' where ur.user_id=#{currentUserId} and ( #{permissions} is null or #{permissions} = '' or exists ( select 1 from sys_role_menu rm inner join sys_menu m on m.menu_id=rm.menu_id where rm.role_id=r.role_id and m.status='0' and m.perms is not null and m.perms != '' and find_in_set(m.perms, #{permissions}) > 0 ) ) and ( r.data_scope='1' or (r.data_scope='2' and c.dept_id in (select dept_id from sys_role_dept where role_id=r.role_id)) or (r.data_scope='3' and c.dept_id=#{currentDeptId}) or (r.data_scope='4' and c.dept_id in (select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id=#{currentDeptId} or find_in_set(#{currentDeptId}, sd.ancestors))) or (r.data_scope='5' and (c.owner_id=#{currentUserId} or c.main_lawyer_id=#{currentUserId} or find_in_set(#{currentUserId}, ifnull(c.assistant_lawyer_ids,'')))) ) )

select 'pending' metricKey,count(*) metricValue from biz_case c where c.del_flag='0' and c.case_status='pending' union all select 'todayNew',count(*) from biz_case c where c.del_flag='0' and date(c.create_time)=curdate() union all select 'transferPending',count(*) from biz_case_transfer t left join biz_case c on c.case_id=t.case_id where c.del_flag='0' and t.transfer_status='pending' union all select 'highLoadLawyers',count(*) from (select c.main_lawyer_id, sum(ifnull(c.estimated_workload,0)) workload from biz_case c where c.del_flag='0' and c.case_status in ('processing','transfering') and c.main_lawyer_id is not null group by c.main_lawyer_id having workload >= 80) x union all select 'avgAssignDays',round(avg(timestampdiff(hour, c.create_time, a.create_time))/24,1) from biz_case c left join biz_case_assignment a on a.case_id=c.case_id where c.del_flag='0' and a.assignment_id is not null

select u.user_id userId, u.nick_name lawyerName, u.nick_name nickName, d.dept_name deptName, coalesce(p.lawyer_role,'lawyer') lawyerRole, coalesce(p.specialties,'business') specialties, coalesce(p.load_limit,100) loadLimit, p.assign_enabled assignEnabled, coalesce(sum(case when c.case_status in ('processing','transfering') then c.estimated_workload else 0 end),0) currentLoad, round(coalesce(sum(case when c.case_status in ('processing','transfering') then c.estimated_workload else 0 end),0) / coalesce(p.load_limit,100) * 100,0) loadRate, count(case when c.case_status in ('processing','transfering') then 1 end) activeCases, count(case when date_format(c.update_time,'%Y%m')=date_format(sysdate(),'%Y%m') then 1 end) monthAssigned, coalesce(p.avg_response_hours,4.0) avgResponseHours from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id inner join biz_lawyer_profile p on p.user_id=u.user_id left join biz_case c on c.main_lawyer_id=u.user_id and c.del_flag='0' where u.del_flag='0' and u.status='0' and p.assign_enabled='Y' and (u.nick_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or d.dept_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or p.specialties like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')) and p.lawyer_role=#{lawyerRole} and find_in_set(#{specialty}, p.specialties) group by u.user_id,u.nick_name,d.dept_name,p.lawyer_role,p.specialties,p.load_limit,p.assign_enabled,p.avg_response_hours order by loadRate asc, activeCases asc, monthAssigned asc

select p.specialties itemName, count(*) itemValue from sys_user u inner join biz_lawyer_profile p on p.user_id=u.user_id where u.del_flag='0' and u.status='0' and p.assign_enabled='Y' group by p.specialties

select p.profile_id profileId, u.user_id userId, u.user_name userName, u.nick_name nickName, u.nick_name lawyerName, d.dept_name deptName, p.lawyer_role lawyerRole, p.specialties specialties, coalesce(p.load_limit,100) loadLimit, coalesce(p.avg_response_hours,4.0) avgResponseHours, coalesce(p.assign_enabled,'N') assignEnabled, p.remark, p.create_time createTime, p.update_time updateTime from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id left join biz_lawyer_profile p on p.user_id=u.user_id where u.del_flag='0' and u.status='0' and (u.user_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or u.nick_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or d.dept_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or p.specialties like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')) and p.lawyer_role=#{lawyerRole} and find_in_set(#{specialty}, p.specialties) and coalesce(p.assign_enabled,'N')=#{assignEnabled} order by coalesce(p.assign_enabled,'N') desc, case when p.profile_id is null then 1 else 0 end, u.dept_id asc, u.user_id asc

select p.profile_id profileId, u.user_id userId, u.user_name userName, u.nick_name nickName, u.nick_name lawyerName, d.dept_name deptName, p.lawyer_role lawyerRole, p.specialties specialties, coalesce(p.load_limit,100) loadLimit, coalesce(p.avg_response_hours,4.0) avgResponseHours, coalesce(p.assign_enabled,'N') assignEnabled, p.remark, p.create_time createTime, p.update_time updateTime from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id left join biz_lawyer_profile p on p.user_id=u.user_id where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.del_flag='0' and u.status='0'
mapper.update: update biz_lawyer_profile set lawyer_role=#{lawyerRole}, specialties=#{specialties}, load_limit=#{loadLimit}, avg_response_hours=#{avgResponseHours}, assign_enabled=#{assignEnabled}, remark=#{remark}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate() where user_id=#{userId}

update biz_case_confirm set confirm_status=#{confirmResult}, handler_id=#{handlerId}, handler_name=#{handlerName}, remark=#{remark}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate() where confirm_id=#{confirmId} and confirm_status=#{expectedStatus}
mapper.select: select cf.*, c.case_no caseNo, c.case_name caseName, c.case_status caseStatus from biz_case_confirm cf left join biz_case c on c.case_id=cf.case_id where cf.confirm_id=#{confirmId} and c.del_flag='0'
